Definition: a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina)
BiblicalUsage: 1) bird trap, trap, snare; 1a) bird trap (literal); 1b) of calamities, plots, source or agent of calamity (fig.); 2) plate (of metal)
